description: A growing directory of self-contained use-case scripts (mix_install_examples style: one .exs per use case, runnable with 'elixir examples/<name>.exs'). Each example implements a real use case in pure Elixir and with defk, checks they agree, measures both, and prints a machine-readable DEFK_RESULT line with a verdict. examples/run_all.exs aggregates them into a scoreboard. The catalog must include poor fits too, so the docs can say clearly what defk is good at and what not to use it for.
title: Example catalog: where defk is (and is not) the right tool
